'''Lanelle''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' from [[Seanchan]].

== Activities ==
She is present when [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] warns King [[Beslan Mitsobar]] not to cause a revolt against the Seanchan.

== Notes ==
* She may be the same individual as [[Ianelle]] with the slightly different name being due to a publication error, but this is unknown.
